assumptions: Use only27.5S and30.3S source sections inside the selected15–32S coastal-jet reference extent. Other Table1 sections belong to broader source EAC system and do not extend this route.
Source depth maxima and cross-sectional areas share one fixed mean−0.05m/s contour mask and one1994-01-01 to2016-10-01 simulation period.
Map source nominal section latitudes to an OSW editorial drawing; this is not a source-traced current axis or recovered cross-section plane.
Assume linear depth/area variation in reference distance between the two compatible sections; leave the rest unknown.

For the separate regional volume scenario, treat reported cross-shore areas as normal sections of the editorial route. Exact orientation correction for the20degree-clockwise source grid is not recovered or applied.
Integrate reported areas directly. Offshore distance is not current width, and maximum depth does not imply a rectangular cross section.
This is a regional extrusion of mean-field mask geometry, not observed water volume, mean instantaneous volume, whole-current volume, annual extrema or a global total.
